card.name: The unit mg after a dose number
card.fires_on: The unit word mg right after a dose amount in dosing sentences, often before a slash or a frequency. Weaker cases are 'solution' after a percentage and the middle of 'catabolism'.

modes.label: mg after a number
modes.description: The measure mg follows a stated dose amount in a dosing statement.
modes.example: Promethazine hydrochloride injection in doses of 50<< mg>> will provide sedation and relieve apprehension

modes.label: mg before per-kg
modes.description: The measure mg follows a number and is followed by /kg or /20 min.
modes.example: a study comparing prothrombin time AUC (0-120 hr) following dosing with warfarin (0.75<< mg>>/kg) before and after 21

modes.label: Other medical words
modes.description: Occasional hits on 'solution' after a percent strength or inside a long word like catabolism.
modes.example: The usual dose is 3 to 4 g (30 to 40 mL of a 10%<< solution>>) administered IV over 30 seconds
